title: Quality Inspection Report
description: Quality Inspection Report contract normalized from the DocuBricks Manufacturing library.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Form
metadata:
  name: docubricks-manufacturing-quality-inspection-report
  title: Quality Inspection Report
  description: Quality Inspection Report contract normalized from the DocuBricks Manufacturing library.
  version: manufacturing_quality_inspection_report_v1
  source:
    system: docubricks
    sourceId: manufacturing/quality_inspection_report
    sourcePath: Schemas/manufacturing/quality_inspection_report
    sourceVersion: manufacturing_quality_inspection_report_v1
    sourceDigest: 1eb5690cf2f749bea18a91741402c91d4739d29a54597b42f8d08e46f4ebfdfd
spec:
  role: review
  pages:
    - id: main
      title: Quality Inspection Report
      sections:
        - id: dates-and-terms
          title: Dates And Terms
          description: Dates And Terms fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: inspection-date
              name: inspection_date
              label: Inspection Date
              description: Inspection date.
              dataType: date
              widget: date
              required: true
        - id: document-details
          title: Document Details
          description: Document Details fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: inspection-report-number
              name: inspection_report_number
              label: Inspection Report Number
              description: Inspection report number.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
              required: true
            - id: part-revision
              name: part_revision
              label: Part Revision
              description: Part revision.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: sample-size
              name: sample_size
              label: Sample Size
              description: Sample size inspected.
              dataType: integer
              widget: number
            - id: inspection-characteristics
              name: inspection_characteristics
              label: Inspection Characteristics
              description: Measured characteristics with specification, result, and disposition.
              dataType: array
              widget: textarea
              required: true
              span: 2
            - id: defect-count
              name: defect_count
              label: Defect Count
              description: Count of defects found.
              dataType: integer
              widget: number
        - id: parties
          title: Parties
          description: Parties fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: supplier-or-work-center
              name: supplier_or_work_center
              label: Supplier Or Work Center
              description: Supplier, work center, or production cell.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: inspector-name
              name: inspector_name
              label: Inspector Name
              description: Inspector name.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: approval-name
              name: approval_name
              label: Approval Name
              description: Quality approver name.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
        - id: property-or-asset
          title: Property Or Asset
          description: Property Or Asset fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: part-number
              name: part_number
              label: Part Number
              description: Part number inspected.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
              required: true
            - id: lot-number
              name: lot_number
              label: Lot Number
              description: Lot, batch, or serial group inspected.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
              required: true
        - id: risk-and-compliance
          title: Risk And Compliance
          description: Risk And Compliance fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: overall-disposition
              name: overall_disposition
              label: Overall Disposition
              description: Accepted, rejected, rework, use-as-is, or other disposition.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
              required: true
  validationRules:
    - id: inspection-report-number-present
      severity: error
      description: inspection_report_number is required for Quality Inspection Report extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: inspection_report_number
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: inspection_report_number
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: inspection_report_number IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(inspection_report_number)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: inspection-date-present
      severity: error
      description: inspection_date is required for Quality Inspection Report extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: inspection_date
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: inspection_date
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: inspection_date IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(inspection_date)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: part-number-present
      severity: error
      description: part_number is required for Quality Inspection Report extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: part_number
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: part_number
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: part_number IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(part_number)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: lot-number-present
      severity: error
      description: lot_number is required for Quality Inspection Report extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: lot_number
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: lot_number
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: lot_number IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(lot_number)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: inspection-characteristics-present
      severity: error
      description: inspection_characteristics is required for Quality Inspection Report extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: inspection_characteristics
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: inspection_characteristics
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: inspection_characteristics IS NOT NULL AND JSON_ARRAY_LENGTH(inspection_characteristics) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: overall-disposition-present
      severity: error
      description: overall_disposition is required for Quality Inspection Report extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: overall_disposition
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: overall_disposition
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: overall_disposition IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(overall_disposition)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: sample-size-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: sample_size should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: sample_size
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: sample_size
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: sample_size IS NULL OR sample_size >= 0
      supported: true
    - id: defect-count-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: defect_count should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: defect_count
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: defect_count
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: defect_count IS NULL OR defect_count >= 0
      supported: true
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.75
    fieldConfidence:
      inspection_report_number:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Quality Inspection Report workflow.
      part_number:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Quality Inspection Report workflow.
      lot_number:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Quality Inspection Report workflow.
      overall_disposition:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Quality Inspection Report workflow.
      inspection_date:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Required field for Quality inspection report extraction.
      inspection_characteristics:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Required field for Quality inspection report extraction.
  modelRouting:
    primary: databricks-claude-sonnet
    fallbackChain:
      - databricks-meta-llama-3-70b-instruct
    maxTokens: 6144
    temperature: 0
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    maxRetries: 2
    tierOverrides: {}
    rationale: Quality Inspection Report documents combine manufacturing, quality, supplier, material, and
      operational control context.
  submissionSchema:
    type: object
    properties:
      inspection_report_number:
        type: string
        description: Inspection report number.
      inspection_date:
        type: date
        description: Inspection date.
        format: date
      part_number:
        type: string
        description: Part number inspected.
      part_revision:
        type: string
        description: Part revision.
      lot_number:
        type: string
        description: Lot, batch, or serial group inspected.
      supplier_or_work_center:
        type: string
        description: Supplier, work center, or production cell.
      sample_size:
        type: integer
        description: Sample size inspected.
      inspection_characteristics:
        type: array
        items:
          type: object
          properties:
            characteristic:
              type: string
              description: Inspected characteristic.
            specification:
              type: string
              description: Specification or tolerance.
            measured_value:
              type: string
              description: Measured value.
            result:
              type: string
              description: Pass, fail, accepted, rejected, or other result.
        description: Measured characteristics with specification, result, and disposition.
      defect_count:
        type: integer
        description: Count of defects found.
      overall_disposition:
        type: string
        description: Accepted, rejected, rework, use-as-is, or other disposition.
      inspector_name:
        type: string
        description: Inspector name.
      approval_name:
        type: string
        description: Quality approver name.
    required:
      - inspection_report_number
      - inspection_date
      - part_number
      - lot_number
      - inspection_characteristics
      - overall_disposition
    additionalProperties: false
    x-ladder-docubricks:
      completenessChecklist:
        - id: required_fields_present
          description: All required fields are present or explicitly null with low confidence when absent.
          fields:
            - inspection_report_number
            - inspection_date
            - part_number
            - lot_number
            - inspection_characteristics
            - overall_disposition
        - id: section_coverage_reviewed
          description: Each declared section was reviewed for extractable evidence.
          sections:
            - dates_and_terms
            - document_details
            - parties
            - property_or_asset
            - risk_and_compliance
        - id: nested_lists_normalized
          description: Object array fields use their item_schema for consistent nested extraction.
          fields:
            - inspection_characteristics
